Reproduced and root-caused. Nothing fixed.

## The bug

`src/app/features/board.jsx:191`:

```jsx
ref={(el) => el && setTimeout(() => el.focus(), 0)}
```

This looks like "focus the search box when it appears." It isn't. An **inline** ref callback is a fresh function identity every render, so React detaches and re-attaches it on every commit — meaning `focus()` fires on **every render of `<Board>`**, not once at mount.

I measured it rather than assuming: instrumenting `input.focus` and forcing three unrelated re-renders gave **3 renders → 3 focus calls**.

## Why it bites constantly

Two independent render sources keep firing while the box is open:

- `App.jsx:78` polls every 4s and `setProj(s)` assigns a **fresh object**, so Board's props change identity every 4 seconds. Board isn't memoised.
- Each card's `onMouseEnter` calls `setHover` (`board.jsx:219`) — so merely moving the mouse across the board steals focus instantly, no poll needed.

The `setTimeout(…, 0)` makes it worse: the steal lands a macrotask after the commit, so it beats React's own focus restoration and can't be traced back to the render that caused it.

## The masking detail worth knowing

`onBlur` closes the box when the query is empty (`board.jsx:196`), so the input unmounts before it can steal anything. **The bug only shows once you've typed a query** — which is exactly the state a searching user is in. Any repro attempt without typing will look fine.

## Two things that change the fix

- **⌘K and `/` already exist** and work (`board.jsx:120-123`). Nothing to add there.
- **Deleting the ref is not sufficient** — those shortcuts set `searchOpen` but depend on this ref to actually place the caret. The fix has to key off *the intent to open*, not off rendering.

## Artifacts

- `repro.md` — rewritten (it held a stale repro from task #105).
- `src/app/__tests__/board-search-focus.test.jsx` — 4 cases: 2 fail (the bug: poll re-render, card hover), 2 pass (behaviour a fix must preserve: click-to-open focuses, first render doesn't).

No source files touched; `git status` shows only `repro.md` and the new spec.

One caveat on the suite: the full run is **283 tests, 3 failed**. The third, `create-pr.test.js > falls back with the compose URL when gh is not on PATH`, is pre-existing and environmental — it asserts behaviour for a machine without the GitHub CLI, and `gh` is installed here at `/usr/bin/gh`. Unrelated to this task; I flagged it in `repro.md` but left it alone.

Fit check: this is a genuine single **Bugfix** — one root cause, one line, one file. Proceeded with the fix.

## Root cause

`src/app/features/board.jsx:191` used an inline ref callback:

```jsx
ref={(el) => el && setTimeout(() => el.focus(), 0)}
```

React re-invokes an inline ref on every commit, so this was `focus()` **per render**, not per mount. `<Board>` re-renders on the 4s poll (`App.jsx:78`) and on every card hover (`setHover`), so the caret got yanked back into the search box constantly.

## The fix (board.jsx only)

- **Stable ref** — `useRef` + `ref={searchRef}`, so rendering the board no longer touches focus.
- **Focus on the intent to open** — a `useEffect` keyed on `searchOpen` fires only on the `false → true` transition (🔍 click, `/`, ⌘K). The `setTimeout(…, 0)` is gone, so focus lands inside the commit instead of a macrotask later.
- **⌘K while already open** — a state the fix newly makes reachable: `setSearchOpen(true)` is then a no-op with no mount to piggyback on, so the shortcut handler focuses the ref directly. That's the report's explicit requirement.

I checked the shared path rather than patching call sites: `grep -rn "ref={(el)" src/` finds no other render-coupled focus, and the remaining `autoFocus` uses (`nav.jsx:206`, `task.jsx:587`, `onboarding.jsx:192`/`269`, `board.jsx:62`) are React's mount-only declarative prop inside modals the user just opened — correct as-is.

## Tests

`src/app/__tests__/board-search-focus.test.jsx` — the repro stage's 4 cases now pass, and I added 2 for the shortcut path (⌘K opens-and-focuses; ⌘K re-focuses an already-open box). 6/6 passing.

Full suite: 285 tests, 284 passed, 1 failed — `create-pr.test.js > falls back with the compose URL when gh is not on PATH`, the pre-existing failure `repro.md` flagged (it asserts behaviour for a machine without `gh`, which is installed here). Unrelated, untouched.
